description.value:
“By the time anyone says your name out loud, you’re already three farms over.”

Skittering Horror. You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. You have reroll the lowest die on Intrigue (Stealth (Intrigue) (Intrigue) (Intrigue)) checks [TODO(adv-call)] made in darkness, ruins, or confined environments such as bunkers, farmsteads, or dense structures.

Night-Feeder. When you attack a creature that is surprised, unconscious, restrained, or isolated from its allies, you have reroll the lowest die on the first attack roll you make against it this turn [TODO(adv-call)].

First Strike (1/a Soma Break). When you hit a creature meeting any of those conditions, the strike deals an additional 1d6 damage of the weapon’s type.
